purpose: Minimum source-gated HK law assistant readiness gates before private books/forms may influence product answers.
overall_rule: No source card means no final legal proposition. Private or licensed sources may be uploaded only into private storage and may not become answer-safe without source validation and lawyer review.

target_user_experience.short_name: Claude-like HK law answer with evidence
must_not_do: show raw vector scores in main answer
quote or reproduce proprietary books/forms in public output
estimate legal outcome without missing-fact caveats
reuse cached answers after source cards become stale or rejected

gates.label: Corpus input and licence controls
gates.minimum_green_condition: Every source is registered before parsing; private/licensed material is private_vault_only or metadata_only_no_raw.
gates.notes: The registry and storage bucket scaffold exists. Large public case corpus and licensed-book ingestion are not complete.

gates.label: Legal processing and structured objects
gates.minimum_green_condition: Cases become paragraph cards; forms become field metadata; propositions include exact supporting quotes found in source text.
gates.notes: The inconsistent-pleadings vertical demonstrates this, but large-scale parsing is not yet production-complete.

gates.label: Embedding and vector storage
gates.minimum_green_condition: Structured legal objects are embedded into Qdrant with jurisdiction/source/review/visibility/firm filters.
gates.notes: Payload builders exist. Live Qdrant indexing requires QDRANT_URL and embedding settings.

gates.label: Retrieval and reranking
gates.minimum_green_condition: Retrieval is hybrid and contract-filtered before the answer renderer sees results.
gates.notes: A deterministic source-gated reranker exists. Production vector/cross-encoder reranking is still pending.

gates.label: Authority treatment and source-gated answer
gates.minimum_green_condition: Every final legal proposition links to a source/proposition card and authority role.
gates.notes: The first vertical has a professional composer. Broad HK law domains need more verified cards and cross-checking.

gates.label: Review, promotion and evaluation
gates.minimum_green_condition: Machine candidates stay research-only until quote/source/lawyer review promotes them.
gates.notes: Review queue and initial evals exist. Domain-wide legal answer quality evals are incomplete.

gates.label: Stored retrieved law and SOP cache
gates.minimum_green_condition: Reviewed retrieval bundles and SOP answers can be reused until source fingerprints or review statuses change.
gates.notes: Database tables and cache helpers exist. Query endpoint write/read integration is the next step.

gates.label: Private source access controls
gates.minimum_green_condition: Private books/forms can be retrieved only for authorized users and never leak full proprietary text into public output.
gates.notes: Policy fields exist. Full tenant auth and namespace enforcement still need production wiring.

allowed_now: store raw file in private vault
not_allowed_until_green: treat book text as answer-safe law
publish full book/form text in repo
embed licensed material into public namespace
generate filing-ready forms without approved template and lawyer review

scale_ladder.target: 100k-200k public judgments where legally and technically available
